snippet.title: Luminas: Parasite Reign - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
⚔️ Face the Parasites. Defy the Bosses.

Enter Luminas: Parasite Reign, a fast-paced roguelite video game where your choices shape every run. Control up to 3 unique Luminas and unleash devastating spells against endless waves of Parasites.
Build powerful party synergies, unlock evolving skill trees, and survive through procedurally generated maps filled with unique enemies and bosses.

🔥 Features:
 • 8 playable Luminas, each with their own playstyle and evolutions
 • Dynamic maps: Grasslands, Ice Peaks, and Fire Ruins
 • Deep build variety through treasures, relics, and spells
 • Fast-paced, chaotic combat built in Unreal Engine 5
